notes: FX6 (post-UAT fix round, decision A16-2; four-role finding S-D3): interconnector imports in the day-ahead clearing of the default PSM. A method change of the corrected profile only (Q13: saved Studies need explicit confirmation); the doctoral reproduction profile keeps the thesis behaviour, where imports are offered only in the balancing stage.
The switch is one field of NativeMarketRules (gridform_core/builtin/scheme_c_1000twh/native_market_rules.py FIELD_CORRECTIONS, interconnector_import_stage).

advisory.title: Interconnector imports cleared only in the balancing stage
advisory.summary: In this Run the default PSM offered interconnector imports only in the balancing stage, for the upward requirement left when realised demand exceeded the day-ahead schedule (the thesis rule). Imports did not compete with domestic generation in the day-ahead clearing, so a positive import availability changes the results only in periods with such a residual requirement.

corrections.description: Each interconnector with a positive transfer constraint in the period (available import capacity, MW) offers to the day-ahead clearing at the period's counterparty price times the bid multiplier, in the same merit order as domestic generation (generation before an import before storage at an equal 0.01 GBP/MWh band). The balancing stage offers only the import capacity the day-ahead schedule left, so no MW is sold twice. An accepted day-ahead import can be reduced in the curtailment branch at its avoided import price (no curtailment payment). Exports (negative transfer constraint) are unchanged.
